_comment: Design-quality benchmark businesses (scripts/design_benchmark.py). Invented businesses: names, copy and facts are fixtures, not real organisations. `summary` is the evidence a source would carry; the archetype is read from it, never given.

businesses.name: Tadika Seri Mutiara
businesses.positioning: A community kindergarten in Kajang since 1992, preparing children aged 4 to 6 for primary school.
businesses.audience: Parents of 4 to 6 year olds in Kajang
businesses.summary: Tadika Seri Mutiara is a kindergarten in Kajang, Selangor, teaching children aged 4 to 6 since 1992. We follow the KSPK national preschool curriculum in Bahasa Malaysia, English and Mandarin, with reading, writing and counting that prepare every child for primary school. Morning and full-day sessions. Visit us to see the classrooms.

hero: Ready for Standard One, the Seri Mutiara way
KSPK curriculum in three languages for children aged 4 to 6 in Kajang.
about: Founded by two teachers in 1992, we have prepared generations of Kajang children for school with patience and structure.

businesses.name: Maple & Moss Montessori
businesses.positioning: A premium Montessori casa in Bangsar with AMI-trained guides and a prepared environment.
businesses.audience: Families seeking an authentic Montessori education
businesses.summary: Maple & Moss is a Montessori preschool in Bangsar. Our AMI-trained guides work in a calm prepared environment with natural wooden materials, mixed-age classrooms and uninterrupted three-hour work cycles for children from 18 months to 6 years. Practical life, sensorial, language and mathematics. Book a school tour to observe a work cycle.

hero: An authentic Montessori casa in Bangsar, guided by AMI-trained teachers.
about: We observe before we guide, and we let concentration grow without interruption.

businesses.name: Kinderloop
businesses.positioning: A modern childcare centre for working parents in Cyberjaya with extended hours and daily app updates.
businesses.summary: Kinderloop is a childcare centre and daycare in Cyberjaya for working parents. Infant care from 3 months, toddler and preschool rooms, open 7am to 7pm. Parents get photo updates in our app, and every room has a qualified early childhood educator. WhatsApp us to check availability.

hero: Childcare that fits a working day
Infant, toddler and preschool rooms in Cyberjaya, open 7am to 7pm.
about: Two working parents built the centre they could not find.

businesses.name: Brainy Bunch Enrichment
businesses.positioning: After-school and weekend enrichment classes for children aged 5 to 12 in Puchong.
businesses.summary: Brainy Bunch is an enrichment centre in Puchong running after-school and weekend classes for children aged 5 to 12: phonics, coding for kids, art, and abacus mental arithmetic. Small classes, termly schedules, trial class available.

hero: After school, the fun kind of learning
Phonics, coding, art and abacus classes for ages 5 to 12 in Puchong.
about: A centre that started with one abacus class
Ten years later we teach four subjects to over three hundred children.

businesses.name: Little Nest Nursery
businesses.positioning: A small, home-like nursery for babies and toddlers in Petaling Jaya.
businesses.summary: Little Nest is a small home-like nursery and baby care centre in Petaling Jaya for babies and toddlers from 6 months to 3 years. Gentle routines, unhurried naps and feeding on each baby's own schedule, and carers who stay with the same little group every day.

hero: A gentle first place away from home
Baby and toddler care in Petaling Jaya, on your little one's own rhythm.
about: A nursery that feels like home
We kept Little Nest small on purpose.

businesses.name: Ledgerly
businesses.positioning: Accounts payable automation for finance teams at growing companies.
businesses.summary: Ledgerly is an accounts payable automation platform for finance teams. Capture invoices, route approval workflows and pay suppliers in one place, with integrations for Xero and QuickBooks. Start a free 14-day trial or book a demo.

hero: Close the month without chasing invoices
Capture, approve and pay supplier invoices in one workflow.
about: We spent ten years closing books by hand.

businesses.name: Kinetic Systems
businesses.positioning: IT managed services and network infrastructure for SMEs in Penang.
businesses.audience: Owners and office managers of small businesses
businesses.summary: Kinetic Systems provides IT managed services for SMEs in Penang: helpdesk support, network infrastructure, cloud migration, cybersecurity and CCTV installation, with 24/7 support contracts. Call our support line or request an IT assessment.

hero: Managed IT, networks and cybersecurity for Penang SMEs, with 24/7 support.
about: We look after the IT of over 120 local businesses.

businesses.name: Studio Halftone
businesses.positioning: An independent design studio for brand identity and web design.
businesses.audience: Founders and marketing leads of ambitious brands
businesses.summary: Studio Halftone is an independent design studio in Kuala Lumpur: brand identity, web design and development, and art direction. See selected work and case studies, then start a project with us.

hero: Brands with a point of view
Identity, web and art direction from an independent studio in Kuala Lumpur.
features: Design and build in one place
about: Six designers and developers who care about craft.

businesses.name: Meridian Advisory
businesses.positioning: A technology consultancy for banks and insurers.
businesses.audience: CIOs and transformation leaders in financial services
businesses.summary: Meridian Advisory is a technology consultancy for banks and insurers: digital transformation strategy, enterprise architecture, cloud adoption and data governance. Our consultants have led core banking programmes across Southeast Asia. Speak to a partner.

hero: Strategy, architecture and data governance for financial institutions.
about: Our partners have run core banking programmes themselves.
